title: Demand Generation Manager
description:
About Needletail AI

Needletail AI is a fully managed dental insurance verification service for US dental group practices and DSOs. The team is based in Kochi, Kerala, India. The buyers are in the US: owners, CFOs and RCM leaders at groups with 3 to 25 locations. Marketing here is small, fast, and it sits close to revenue.

**Applications - Please submit your resume through our official careers page to be considered for this position: https://www.needletailai.com/careers**

The role

Your north star is one number: 40 new ICP demos a month, reached within your first 90 days. An ICP demo is a held call with a decision-maker at a US dental group or DSO with 3 to 25 locations. Everything in this role, organic and paid, exists to move it.

You will report to the Head of Growth. You will plan, launch, measure and kill campaigns across search, paid, content, email and the website.

We are not hiring someone to manage agencies and send weekly decks. We are hiring someone who ships a campaign on Monday, reads the data on Thursday, and has an agent doing the boring half of it by the following week.

Success at 12 months looks like this: a demo engine that holds 90 or more ICP demos every month without heroics, a clear cost per ICP demo by channel, and a marketing stack where most repeatable work is automated and documented.

What you will own

* **Campaign engine.** Plan, launch, measure, and scale or kill multi-channel campaigns, built around dental moments like the January benefits rollover.
* **Paid.** Google, Microsoft and LinkedIn Ads: budgets, bids, search terms, creative tests and cost per ICP demo.
* **Organic and AI search.** Direct our SEO agency, own conversion on high-intent pages, and grow how we show up in AI answers.
* **Website and conversion.** Landing pages, demo flow, forms and tests, shipped yourself with AI and no-code tools.
* **Lead magnets and nurture.** Turn tools, guides and reports into offers, and build nurture that turns a download into a booked call.
* **Measurement.** Attribution from first touch to held demo, and a weekly readout of what worked and what comes next.
* **Agents and automation.** Build the AI workflows that handle research, list building, reporting and QA.
* **Partner with outbound and sales.** Feed audiences to outbound, and close the loop on lead quality with sales.

Who you are: must-haves

* 3 to 5 years in B2B marketing, with most of it at a SaaS or tech startup (seed to Series C) selling to businesses, ideally in the US market.
* You have personally run and grown campaigns, not just coordinated them. You can name a campaign you launched, the numbers before and after, and what you changed in between. You have owned a monthly pipeline or demo target, and you can tell us how often you hit it.
* Hands-on with paid search and paid social: you have built accounts, written the ads, managed the budget and cut what did not work.
* Strong with funnels and data: HubSpot (or a similar CRM), GA4, UTMs and attribution. You can find why demos dropped last week without asking an analyst.
* You write clearly for busy American buyers, and you can tell a strong landing page from a weak one in under a minute.
* You work well with little structure. You surface problems early, say what you will do, and then do it.
* Based in Kochi, Kerala, India, or willing to relocate, working from our Kochi office.

What this role is not

* Not a team-lead role on day one. You will work with a small team and agencies, and grow scope by results.
* Not a reporting job. If you prefer analyzing campaigns to launching them, this is the wrong seat.

Compensation, location and how we hire

* **Compensation:** ₹9 to 12 LPA fixed, based on experience.
* **Location:** Kochi, Kerala, India. Full-time, in office.
* **Start:** as soon as possible.

**How we hire (about two weeks):**

* Complete the assignment below, then apply through our official company careers page: https://www.needletailai.com/careers by submitting your CV and Hub link. Applications without a working Hub link will not be considered.
* 45-minute call with the Head of Growth, walkthrough of your marketing hub: how it works, the prompts and tools behind it, and what you would build next.
* Conversation with our Co-Founder and CEO.

The Assignment: build a marketing hub

Build one web page (a marketing campaign hub) with any LLM or AI tool and host it publicly. Build it for a fictional dental insurance verification company, with a brand name and look you make up, selling to our ICP. On it, show us how you would get that company to 40 ICP demos a month:

* A landing page for your search ads, aimed at one segment of our ICP.
* Ad copy for a Google search campaign.
* Your campaign plan: objective, channels, how you'd spend $1,500 a month, and how you'd measure it.

Add a short note on how you used AI and why you want to join Needletail.

**Use AI to build, not to think.** Use any AI tool to code and design the hub and the landing page. The creative ideas, strategy and copy must be entirely your own. If we find that AI wrote any of them, your application is rejected in the first round. Expect to walk us through every line in the interview.

**Rules.** One public link that opens without sign-up; no Drive, Dropbox or other file-sharing links, documents or PDFs. Don't use Needletail's name, brand or logo anywhere on the page. Use only public information. Label any number you assume, and don't copy claims from Needletail or any real company. You keep ownership of your work.

We look at buyer understanding, campaign thinking, copy, and how you use AI to build. Rough and working beats polished.

Pay: ₹900,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

title: IT Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Location: Kochi (Onsite)**  
**Contract: Permanent, full-time**

**About us:**

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,800+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries and 46+ offices. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly offers over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.

**About the Role**

The IT Infrastructure Engineer is a hands-on role responsible for implementing, managing, securing, and supporting IT infrastructure and Cloud Operations across Cyncly’s global environment.

The role combines CloudOps with ongoing operations, with a strong focus on Azure virtual machines, storage, networking, secure connectivity, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery. The Engineer will translate approved designs into reliable production environments and provide advanced troubleshooting for cloud and network issues.

Experience with Cisco Meraki, Check Point firewalls, and Microsoft Hyper-V will be an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Azure Infrastructure Deployment and Operations**

* Deploy, configure, and administer Azure virtual machines, managed disks, availability configurations, and supporting Windows and Linux workloads.
* Manage Azure Storage accounts, including Blob Storage and Azure Files, covering access controls, redundancy, lifecycle management, and data protection.
* Deploy and support infrastructure-related Azure services, including Azure App Service, Key Vault, Azure Backup, and Azure Site Recovery.
* Manage subscriptions, resource groups, resource naming, tagging, and resource lifecycle activities according to organizational standards.
* Configure Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, alerts, and diagnostic settings to support availability, troubleshooting, and operational visibility.
* Support capacity planning, resource sizing, performance tuning, and cost optimization.

**Azure Networking and Secure Connectivity**

* Deploy and manage Azure Virtual Networks, subnets, network interfaces, IP addressing, and Network Security Groups.
* Configure and troubleshoot virtual network peering, route tables, user-defined routes, and traffic flows between Azure, on-premises environments, and remote locations.
* Implement and support Azure VPN Gateway, site-to-site and point-to-site VPNs, and hybrid connectivity.
* Configure and administer Azure Bastion for secure administrative access to virtual machines.
* Manage Azure DNS, Private DNS zones, Private Endpoints, and connectivity to Azure services.
* Deploy and support Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Web Application Firewall, Azure Firewall, and NAT Gateway, as required.
* Troubleshoot routing, DNS resolution, VPN connectivity, latency, packet loss, and firewall-related issues.
* Collaborate with security teams to implement network segmentation, access restrictions, and secure connectivity standards.

**Automation, Security, and Operational Improvement**

* Develop and maintain automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Terraform, Bicep, or similar tools.
* Apply Infrastructure as Code practices to improve deployment consistency and configuration management.
* Implement role-based access control, managed identities, Azure Policy, and secure secret management in line with approved standards.
* Support patching, vulnerability remediation, infrastructure hardening, and backup and recovery validation.
* Use approved AI tools to assist with scripting, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational improvement, while protecting company information and validating outputs.

**Project Delivery, Support, and Documentation**

* Deliver Azure and network infrastructure projects according to approved designs, schedules, budgets, and change management procedures.
* Plan and execute infrastructure migrations, upgrades, and connectivity changes, including testing, rollback planning, and post-change validation.
* Provide L3/L4 troubleshooting for escalated Azure and network incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.
* Maintain infrastructure diagrams, configuration records, deployment procedures, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides.
* Coordinate operational handovers and knowledge transfer to support teams.
* Participate in on-call support and planned maintenance outside standard working hours, as required.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum of 6 years of hands-on infrastructure engineering experience, preferably 6–8+ years, with substantial experience in Azure administration and networking.
* Strong practical experience deploying and supporting Azure virtual machines, storage accounts, Blob Storage, managed disks, monitoring, and backup services.
* Hands-on experience with Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, NSGs, peering, routing, VPN Gateway, Bastion, DNS, and Private Endpoints.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, subnetting, routing, switching, NAT, VPNs, firewalls, and network troubleshooting.
* Experience administering Windows Server and Linux systems, including their networking and security configurations.
* Proficiency in PowerShell or Azure CLI, with practical experience using an Infrastructure as Code tool.
* Understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, managed identities, and least-privilege access.
* Experience supporting production environments through incident management, change management, and structured troubleshooting.
* Strong communication, documentation, and coordination skills, with the ability to work across global teams.

**Preferred Skills and Certifications**

* Experience with Network, security policies, NAT, VPN configuration, logging, and troubleshooting.
* **Microsoft Hyper-V (Nice to have):** Experience administering virtual machines, virtual switches, failover clusters, and host maintenance.
* Experience with infrastructure migrations and backup and disaster recovery testing.
* Familiarity with ITIL practices and ITSM platforms such as FreshService.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Network Engineer Associate, Cisco CCNA/CCNP, or Check Point CCSA/CCSE.

**Working for us:**

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - come join us.

**Role Title**


EndPoint Infrastructure Patching \& Vulnerability Management Administrator

  

**Function / Portfolio**

Digital Workplace Enablement Services (DWES) – EndPoint Management

  

**Scope**



Patching \& vulnerability remediation of the \~450 on\-prem SCCM/APPPROXY infrastructure servers (CAS, Primary Sites, SQL site databases and supporting server roles)

  



**Job Description Summary**



Maintain and secure the Endpoint Management infrastructure (approximately 450 SCCM and AppProxy servers) by ensuring systems remain patched, hardened, and free of known vulnerabilities. Own the end\-to\-end server patching and remediation lifecycle, including monitoring, validation, deployment coordination, post\-patch verification, and driving vulnerability findings to closure.



The successful candidate will operate the patching lifecycle end to end: monitoring for released fixes, validating them, sequencing and executing patching in coordination with the SCCM and Approxy engineering team, restarting/validating servers, and driving vulnerability findings to closure.



The estate is split across non\-production and production environments and includes the Central Administration Site (CAS), Primary Sites and their SQL site databases, which are the true single point of failure for a site. Work is executed against an accelerated cadence and, when required, under an Emergency/Zero\-Day change model. The role is hands\-on, evidence\-driven and governed by EY change management (RFC / eCAB).

  

**Key Responsibilities**



**Server Patching \& Maintenance**


* Execute monthly, accelerated and emergency patching across the \~450 SCCM/AppProxy servers (non\-production first, then production), following the confirmed environment sequence.
* Sequence patching correctly so Windows/SQL work completes before SCCM/APPPROXY patching in each environment; perform and validate server restarts within the agreed windows.
* Apply Microsoft SCCM/APPPROXY hotfixes and SQL Server cumulative updates (CU/GDR) as prerequisites for a healthy SCCM/APPPROXY platform, coordinating carefully around SQL site databases to avoid taking a whole site down.
* Support High\-Availability failover patching (patch passive node/SQL replica, switch active/passive, patch former active) to minimize outage windows.

  


**Vulnerability Management \& Remediation**


* Own the remediation of vulnerabilities flagged against the SCCM/APPPROXY server estate (e.g. GVM / scanner findings from tools such as Qualys / Tenable), tracking each item to closure within SLA.
* Triage and prioritize findings by criticality (CVSS), separating in\-scope SCCM/APPPROXY/SQL items from those owned by other teams and re\-assigning out\-of\-scope items correctly (accurate CMDB ownership).
* Validate that deployed fixes actually mitigate the reported vulnerability, remove flagged/unnecessary software, and capture evidence for audit and closure.
* Maintain and report remediation status, backlog reduction and platform health metrics to the SCCM/APPPROXY lead and stakeholders.

  


**Coordination, Change \& War Room Operations**


* Liaise daily with the core SCCM/APPPROXY engineering team, SQL/DBA, platform, and service management to plan and execute patch windows.
* Raise and manage changes through EY change management (RFC / eCAB), including emergency/zero\-day changes, respecting change freezes and approvals.
* Provide War Room coverage during patch surges and zero\-day events: readiness checks, live execution, validation, rollback if thresholds are exceeded, and clear stakeholder communication.
* Produce concise, evidence\-based status updates and closure reports for leadership.

  


**Required Skills \& Experience**


* Hands\-on experience administering and patching SCCM/APPPROXY server infrastructure (CAS, Primary Sites, site system roles) in a large enterprise estate.
* Strong Windows Server administration skills (multi\-domain Active Directory) including patching, restart sequencing and post\-patch validation.
* Working knowledge of SQL Server as an SCCM/APPPROXY prerequisite — applying CU/GDR updates and understanding site\-database criticality and Always On / HA concepts.
* Solid understanding of enterprise change management (RFC / CAB / eCAB) and evidence/audit discipline.
* Ability to work under pressure in a War Room / on\-call model across accelerated and emergency patch cycles.

  


**Out of Scope**



To keep the role focused, the following are explicitly not the primary responsibility of this position:


* Day\-to\-day administration of the SCCM/APPPROXY application layer — application packaging/deployment, collections/targeting, task sequences, client health and end\-user device compliance.
* Operating\-system patching governance owned by other platform teams (the role executes/sequences server patching but does not own OS patch policy).
